name: Long-Term Rental with Property Manager

yield.notes: Net after mortgage (if applicable), PM fee (8-12%), maintenance reserve (10% gross), and vacancy. Leverage amplifies returns and risks.

flags: Maintenance reserve: budget 10-15% of gross rent
Landlord-tenant laws vary by state — critical to understand

prerequisites: Significant capital for down payment (20-25% for investment property)
startup_checklist: Research landlord-friendly markets with strong rent-to-price ratios (rent/price > 0.8%)
Get investment property mortgage pre-approval (typically 20-25% down)
Hire property manager before closing — interview 3, check references
Run numbers: gross rent - mortgage - PM fee - maintenance - vacancy = net cash flow
Ensure positive cash flow of at least $200/mo before purchasing
failure_modes: Negative cash flow due to high expenses or vacancy
Major capital repair wipes years of income
Problem tenant with long eviction process
kill_criteria: Cash flow negative for 3+ consecutive quarters
tool_stack_examples: Avail or AppFolio for PM software
sources_note: Strategy from BiggerPockets real estate investing community.
